Episode Leadership Across Seasons

EXPLORE THE DIALOGUE SEASON BY SEASON

Author

Greta Tillery

The other episode comparison groups seasons 1-7 and 15-21. Here, each season is shown separately to make changes over time easier to explore. An episode is kid-led when the four boys have more lines, adult-led when the six selected adults have more, and a tie when their recorded line counts are equal.
